name: Pylon
description: Pylon is a B2B customer support platform that unifies Slack Connect, Microsoft Teams, email, chat widget, and forms into a single ticketing system with knowledge base, accounts/contacts, and AI agent orchestration.
gating_notes: API tokens are created directly in the Pylon dashboard (Settings > API Tokens) by Admin users only, with no separate approval step ('Only Admin users can create API tokens' - docs.usepylon.com/pylon-docs/developer/api). However, API access itself is gated to paid plans: per third-party pricing summaries citing Pylon's own pricing page, API access is only included starting at the Professional tier (not Starter), and Pylon's account signup/pricing page (usepylon.com/pricing) routes to a 'book a demo' flow rather than instant self-serve signup, so getting an account with API-capable plan likely requires a sales conversation. The MCP server additionally requires the 'MCP Access' role to be enabled per-user by an admin.
mcp_notes: Official first-party remote MCP server hosted at https://mcp.usepylon.com, enabled from the Pylon dashboard (Settings > AI Controls > MCP Server). Uses OAuth 2.0 (AuthKit); access is scoped to what the authenticated user can already see in the UI. Exposes tools to search/retrieve/create/update issues, search/retrieve/update accounts, and fetch contacts/team members/current user. Requires 'MCP Access' role enabled per Member/Admin user. Source: docs.usepylon.com/pylon-docs/integrations/pylon-mcp.
